interest: a reusable quiz tool that saves marking time and shows the department innovates
expectation: The sponsor expects the MVP demo in week 7 and a pilot with 50 students in week 14 within the 200 USD cash cap.

interest: delivery of the charter commitments inside 490 h and 200 USD
expectation: The PM expects written sponsor decisions on scope changes within 5 working days and attendance at the week-7 and week-13 gates.

interest: a graded capstone experience and a working product to show employers
expectation: Each student receives a defined role (backend real-time frontend QA/DevOps) and a tagged demo at the end of every build phase.

interest: a fair live quiz with instant feedback and a visible leaderboard
expectation: Each pilot student joins one live session with a 6-character code in week 14 and sees their own score and the leaderboard.

interest: quizzes they can reuse without weekly marking load
expectation: Lecturers receive an account and a short training session before the pilot and can export results to CSV and PDF after it.

interest: no surprises at go-live; a runbook and a backup job
expectation: IT operations receives a deployment checklist and docker-compose.prod.yml two weeks before the pilot.

role: Approves WebSocket through the campus proxy
interest: a stable campus network without unsupported protocols
expectation: The network administrator validates WebSocket or SockJS through the campus proxy by week 5 and approves the firewall change.

interest: clear learning outcomes assessed fairly against the project
expectation: The Software Engineering lecturer receives the tagged phase demos and assesses the capstone against the charter objectives.

interest: student names and results stored on campus with a retention rule
expectation: The data protection officer receives a one-page data description before the pilot and can block the pilot without it.

interest: evidence that the platform is worth adopting across the department
expectation: The dean receives the pilot results and an adoption recommendation by the end of week 14.

role: Contingency supplier if option B of the business case is triggered
interest: licence revenue if the department buys instead of building
expectation: The vendor supplies education pricing and a trial account within five working days if the sponsor triggers the week-7 review gate.
